ui_ux_improvements.title: Localize @xala/ds ConfirmDialog and AlertDialog default button text
ui_ux_improvements.description: The ConfirmDialog and AlertDialog components in @xala/ds have hardcoded Norwegian default strings ('Bekreft', 'Avbryt', 'Lukk', 'Vennligst vent...') which breaks the multi-language experience for English users
ui_ux_improvements.rationale: The CLAUDE.md mandates i18n-first development with useT() hooks. Design system components should accept localized strings or provide i18n integration to support both Norwegian and English users. Currently users see mixed-language UI when using dialogs from the design system.
ui_ux_improvements.current_state: Line 212-213: confirmText='Bekreft' (Norwegian 'Confirm'), cancelText='Avbryt' (Norwegian 'Cancel'). Line 295: Loading state shows hardcoded 'Vennligst vent...' (Norwegian 'Please wait...'). Line 325: closeText='Lukk' (Norwegian 'Close').
ui_ux_improvements.proposed_change: 1. Remove default values from button text props, making them required. This forces consuming apps to explicitly pass localized strings via t('common.confirm'), t('common.cancel'), etc. 2. Alternatively, add an optional i18n prop that accepts a translation function. 3. Update the JSDoc examples to show proper i18n usage pattern. Example: <ConfirmDialog confirmText={t('common.confirm')} cancelText={t('common.cancel')} loadingText={t('common.pleaseWait')} />
ui_ux_improvements.user_benefit: English-speaking municipal staff will see consistent language in confirmation dialogs instead of mixed Norwegian/English UI when interacting with critical actions like delete or cancel

ui_ux_improvements.title: Add i18n support to Backoffice sidebar navigation labels
ui_ux_improvements.description: The backoffice Sidebar.tsx component has all navigation labels and descriptions hardcoded in Norwegian ('Dashboard', 'Oversikt og statistikk', 'Administrasjon', etc.) instead of using the @xala/i18n translation system
ui_ux_improvements.rationale: Unlike minside Sidebar which properly uses useT() for translations, the backoffice sidebar bypasses i18n completely. This violates CLAUDE.md rule: 'NEVER use hardcoded strings in UI components'. Municipal staff who prefer English cannot use the backoffice in their language.
ui_ux_improvements.current_state: Lines 164-234 contain 50+ hardcoded Norwegian strings: 'Dashboard' (167), 'Oversikt og statistikk' (167), 'Listings' (173), 'Administrer utleieobjekter' (173), 'Kalender' (174), 'Visuell oversikt' (174). Section titles 'Administrasjon' (172), 'Kommunikasjon' (181), 'Brukere & Org' (186), etc. are all hardcoded.
ui_ux_improvements.proposed_change: 1. Add import: import { useT } from '@xala/i18n'; 2. Add const t = useT(); in Sidebar function. 3. Replace each hardcoded string: name: t('backoffice.nav.dashboard'), description: t('backoffice.nav.dashboardDesc'). 4. Add 100+ new i18n keys to packages/i18n/src/locales/nb.ts and en.ts under backoffice.nav.* namespace.
ui_ux_improvements.user_benefit: Backoffice admin users can switch to English language and see fully translated navigation, improving accessibility for non-Norwegian speaking municipal staff and consultants

ui_ux_improvements.title: Fix LoadingFallback Spinner size attribute typo (data-data-size)
ui_ux_improvements.description: LoadingFallback.tsx has a typo where 'data-data-size' should be 'data-size', causing the Spinner to render at default size instead of large size during page transitions
ui_ux_improvements.rationale: This is a bug that affects perceived loading performance. When users navigate between routes with lazy loading, they see a small spinner instead of a prominent large spinner. The small spinner can be hard to notice against the full-screen background, making the app feel unresponsive.
ui_ux_improvements.current_state: Line 18: <Spinner aria-label="Laster..." data-data-size="lg" /> - The attribute 'data-data-size' is incorrect (duplicated 'data-' prefix). Additionally, aria-label uses hardcoded Norwegian 'Laster...' instead of i18n.
ui_ux_improvements.proposed_change: 1. Change 'data-data-size="lg"' to 'data-size="lg"' on line 18. 2. Add import { useT } from '@xala/i18n'; 3. Convert to function component to use hooks, or pass aria-label as prop from parent. 4. Change aria-label from hardcoded 'Laster...' to t('common.loading'). Simple one-line fix for the typo, i18n fix requires function component conversion.
ui_ux_improvements.user_benefit: Users will see a properly sized loading spinner during route transitions, providing clearer visual feedback that content is loading. Non-Norwegian users will hear correct screen reader text.

ui_ux_improvements.title: Localize NotificationCenter component all user-facing strings
ui_ux_improvements.description: The NotificationCenter component in @xala/ds has 15+ hardcoded Norwegian strings for filter tabs, empty states, headings, buttons, and ARIA labels that need i18n support
ui_ux_improvements.rationale: Notification center is a high-frequency user interaction point. Having mixed language breaks the user experience for English-speaking users. All text appears in Norwegian regardless of user's language preference.
ui_ux_improvements.current_state: Lines 98-100: Filter tab labels 'Alle', 'Uleste', 'Leste'. Lines 176-189: Empty state messages in Norwegian (3 variations). Line 323: 'Varsler' heading. Line 338: 'Merk alle som lest' button. Line 344: aria-label='Lukk varselssenter'. Line 391: Spinner aria-label='Laster varsler...'
ui_ux_improvements.proposed_change: Add localization props interface: interface NotificationCenterLabels { title: string; filterAll: string; filterUnread: string; filterRead: string; markAllAsRead: string; closeAriaLabel: string; loadingAriaLabel: string; emptyAll: { title: string; description: string }; emptyUnread: { title: string; description: string }; emptyRead: { title: string; description: string }; }. Make labels prop required so consuming apps pass t() values.
ui_ux_improvements.user_benefit: Users viewing the notification center will see consistent language throughout, improving comprehension and accessibility for English-speaking municipal staff

ui_ux_improvements.title: Add visible focus indicator to Drawer close button for keyboard navigation
ui_ux_improvements.description: The Drawer component's close button has hover styles but no visible focus indicator for keyboard users, making it difficult to navigate the drawer using keyboard-only navigation (WCAG 2.4.7 violation)
ui_ux_improvements.rationale: WCAG 2.1 AA requires visible focus indicators (Success Criterion 2.4.7). The close button uses onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave for hover states but has no :focus-visible styling. Keyboard users cannot see when the close button is focused, creating accessibility barrier for users who can't use a mouse.
ui_ux_improvements.current_state: Lines 439-466: Close button has hover states via onMouseEnter (backgroundColor change, color change) and onMouseLeave (reset) but no onFocus/onBlur handlers. The button also has hardcoded aria-label='Lukk' (Norwegian for 'Close') on line 442.
ui_ux_improvements.proposed_change: 1. Add onFocus handler: onFocus={(e) => { e.currentTarget.style.outline = '2px solid var(--ds-color-focus-outer)'; e.currentTarget.style.outlineOffset = '2px'; e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = 'var(--ds-color-neutral-surface-hover)'; }}. 2. Add onBlur handler to reset styles. 3. Add closeAriaLabel prop to DrawerProps interface for localization. 4. Change default from 'Lukk' to 'Close' (English default for design system components).
ui_ux_improvements.user_benefit: Keyboard users will be able to clearly see when the close button is focused while tabbing through the drawer, and screen reader users will hear localized labels appropriate to their language setting
